text:
jia: Heads-up — bringing up tessera-embed-v1 (FP16 trained) with int4 per-tensor quant for staging. Quick smoke: recall@1 on short-query set drops from 0.72 -> 0.59, recall@10 0.91 -> 0.86. Silhouette drops ~0.12 on kmeans-50. Anyone seen this pattern before?
noah: hmm that's pretty large for int4. Is this per-channel quant missing?
sophia: link to the quick numbers? paste the eval command + config pls
jia: paste: `./eval_embeds --model=tessera-embed-v1 --quant=int4 --per_channel=false --dataset=shortquery_v2 --metrics=recall@1,recall@10,silhouette`
ryan: can you also run with `--normalization=l2 --batchnorm-merge=true`? sometimes folding batchnorm into weight helps for these transformers.
jia: ran that just now. recall@1 improved to 0.64, recall@10 0.88, silhouette +0.05. Not back to FP16 baseline though.
noah: what's the per-channel run look like? per-channel quant often fixes centroid drift.
jia: per-channel run queued: command `./eval_embeds --model=tessera-embed-v1 --quant=int4 --per_channel=true --dataset=shortquery_v2` (started at 1708202100).
sophia: also try asymmetric vs symmetric quantizers? sometimes symmetric int4 clamps tails badly.
ryan: add the topk distribution check: `python tools/topk_overlap.py --base=fp16_out.npy --quant=quant_out.npy --k=1,5,10`
noah: if per-channel doesn't fix, check KV cache ordering microbatching — we had a bug before where microbatch padding changed avg sequence length and shifted per-token scaling. Might affect embeddings through layernorm variance.
jia: per-channel finished: recall@1 0.71, recall@10 0.90, silhouette within 0.02 of FP16. Nice.
sophia: great — so per-channel + batchnorm folding wins. Can we add this to quant recommendation for tessera?
ryan: add a follow-up: run contrastive holdout with noise-augmented queries (10% token-drop) to ensure stability. I can take that.
jia: thanks — creating ticket: ENGML-1142 to update quant profiles + add automated nightly check. tagging @dev-eval-bot to kick the holdout run.
dev-eval-bot: scheduled: contrastive_holdout_noise (tessera-embed-v1, int4-per-channel, 10% token-drop) started at 1708202220. ETA ~15m.
noah: one more thought — document the config: per_channel=true, clamp_strategy=percentile99.9, bn_fold=true. saves future debugging time.
jia: will add to PR and console docs. closing thread for now :thumbsup:
